q: You want to buy some fresh bread and rolls for breakfast in Tashkent.
why: «fresh bread and rolls» yangi pishirilgan non va bulochkalar sotib oladigan joyni yani «baker's»ni bildiradi.

wrong.butcher's: «butcher's» - go'sht do'koni. Matnda non haqida gap ketmoqda.
wrong.florist's: «florist's» - gul do'koni. Non mahsulotlari bu yerda bo'lmaydi.

q: I need to go to the ______ to put some money into my savings account.
why: «put some money into my savings account» pulni jamg'arma hisob raqamiga qo'yish uchun «bank»ga borish kerakligini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.launderette: «launderette» - kir yuvish shoxobchasi. Pul qo'yib bo'lmaydi.
wrong.post office: «post office» - pochta bo'limi. Hisob raqamlar bilan ishlamaydi.

q: Your mother is cooking plov and needs to buy fresh beef from the market.
why: «fresh beef» yangi mol go'shti «butcher's» (qassobxona) do'konidan sotib olinadi.

wrong.greengrocer's: «greengrocer's» - sabzi va meva do'koni. Go'sht sotilmaydi.

q: You have a terrible headache and need to buy some aspirin urgently.
why: «terrible headache» va «aspirin» dori-darmon sotib olish uchun «chemist's»ga borish kerakligini ko'rsatadi.

q: Let's meet at the ______ in the shopping mall to drink hot cappuccino and chat.
why: «drink hot cappuccino» issiq kapuchino ichish uchun «coffee shop»ga boriladi.

q: Aziza wants to buy a modern winter coat for the cold Tashkent winter.
why: «winter coat» qishki palto «clothes shop» (kiyim-kechak do'koni)dan sotib olinadi.

q: She bought organic face cream and lipstick at the new ______ downtown.
why: «organic face cream and lipstick» yuz kremi va lab bo'yog'i «cosmetics store»da sotiladi.

q: Your father needs to buy new hammers, screws, and paint to fix the fence.
why: «hammers, screws, and paint» bolg'a, burama miq va bo'yoqlar «DIY store» (xo'jalik mollari do'koni)da bo'ladi.

wrong.garden centre: «garden centre» - bog'dorchilik markazi, uy ta'mirlash uchun emas.

q: We went to the ______ to find a comfortable three-room apartment to rent.
why: «find a comfortable three-room apartment to rent» kvartira topish uchun «estate agent's»ga murojaat qilinadi.

wrong.charity shop: «charity shop» - arzon kiyimlar sotiladigan xayriya joyi.

q: You want to buy a beautiful bouquet of red roses for your teacher's birthday.
why: «bouquet of red roses» qizil gullar dastasini «florist's» (gul do'koni)dan sotib olasiz.

wrong.garden centre: «garden centre» - ko'chat va ulkan o'simliklar markazi.

q: My grandparents bought new apple tree saplings and flower pots at the ______.
why: «apple tree saplings and flower pots» olma ko'chatlari va tuvaklar «garden centre»da sotiladi.

q: You need to buy fresh juicy tomatoes, cucumbers, and watermelons for the family dinner.
why: «tomatoes, cucumbers, and watermelons» pomidor, bodring va tarvuzlar «greengrocer's»da bo'ladi.

q: Timur went to the ______ to get a trendy new haircut and style his hair.
why: «trendy new haircut» yangi zamonaviy soch turmagi uchun «hairdresser's»ga boriladi.

q: Your sister is getting married and wants to buy a sparkling gold ring.
why: «sparkling gold ring» tillo uzuk «jeweller's» (zargarlik do'koni)da sotiladi.

q: Our washing machine broke down, so we took our heavy winter duvets to the ______.
why: «washing machine broke down» va «duvets» kir yuvish mashinasi buzilgani uchun «launderette»ga borilganini bildiradi.

q: You want to buy today's local newspaper and a weekly TV guide magazine.
why: «local newspaper and a weekly TV guide magazine» gazeta va jurnallar «newsagent's»da sotiladi.

q: My vision is getting worse, so I need to visit the ______ to get my eyes tested.
why: «vision is getting worse» va «get my eyes tested» ko'zni tekshirish uchun «optician's»ga borishni anglatadi.

q: You need to send an urgent parcel and buy some stamps for your letters to London.
why: «send an urgent parcel and buy some stamps» posilka yuborish va marka sotib olish «post office»da bajariladi.

q: We are too tired to cook tonight, so let's order a hot ______ with spicy chicken.
why: «too tired to cook» va «order a hot... with spicy chicken» uyda ovqat pishirmasdan «takeaway» buyurtma qilishni ko'rsatadi.

q: You are travelling to the USA and need to exchange your Uzbek sums for American paper currency.
why: «USA» va «American paper currency» AQSh pul birligi «dollar» ekanini bildiradi.
